title: Decision point answer front matter
description: The front matter of one answer to a decision point (ws-058, #2739), as `chant workspace points ask` and `points answer` write it into the records directory of a record kind with an `answers` block. One record per point, declaration and inputs: its id is the point's name and the first 12 hex digits of the inputs hash, so the same question is answered once. A table's answer is `answered`; a model's answer at or above its threshold is `proposed` until a person confirms it; a question no decider before the quorum answered is `escalated`, open for people. An answer never changes in place: `points retract` escalates the question to people again and moves the answer into `retractions` (#3351, ws-084). A workspace copies this file next to its answer kind, as reference-workspace/answers/ does. Values stay within what YAML and JSON share. Fields other than these must start with x-.

id.description: The point's name, a hyphen, and the first 12 hex digits of inputs_hash.

point.description: The point in the points file this answers.

point_version.description: sha256 of the point's declaration when it was asked. Editing the question or any decider changes it.

candidates.description: The answers the question allowed: true and false, a choice's options, or a score's levels.

inputs.description: The state the deciders saw, input name to value.

inputs_hash.description: sha256 of the point, its version and its inputs. The same hash is answered once.

constrains.description: What the question is about, such as a work item's id.

model.description: model: the model id that answered, as the backend reported it.

reason.description: model: the model's own explanation of its answer, when the backend gave one (#3345). Kept when a person confirms the proposal; moved into the escalations as model_reason when people answer otherwise.

escalations.description: The deciders asked before the one that answered, or before the quorum, and why each did not answer.

answered_by.description: The people who answered or confirmed it.

note.description: What the people who answered wrote with their answer (`points answer --note`, #3351). Moved into the retraction when the answer is retracted.

retractions.description: Answers people took back, oldest first (`points retract`, #3351): each answer as it was, and who retracted it, when and why. A retracted question is escalated to people again.

source.description: Where the answer came from (#2708): via, client and model, the model id that answered when a model decider did.

decider.description: Who gave it: the record's decider as it was.

model_reason.description: model: the model's own explanation of the answer it gave, when the backend gave one (#3345). reason is why the decider did not answer.
